title: لكي / حتى
form: main clause + so that + subject + can or could + base verb

cells.en: I write notes so that I can remember more.
cells.ar: أكتب ملاحظات لكي أتذكر المزيد.
cells.description: Learner writing notes

cells.en: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
cells.ar: تحدثت ببطء حتى يتمكن الجميع من الفهم.
cells.description: Speaker explaining slowly to a group

cells.en: We left early so that we could catch the train.
cells.ar: خرجنا مبكرًا حتى نلحق بالقطار.
cells.description: Travelers leaving early for a train

cells.en: He saved money so that he could buy a bicycle.
cells.ar: ادخر المال لكي يتمكن من شراء دراجة.
cells.description: Adult saving for a bicycle

cells.en: I raised my hand so that the teacher could see me.
cells.ar: رفعت يدي لكي يراني المعلم.
cells.description: Adult learner raising a hand in class

cells.en: We labeled the boxes so that everyone could find their things.
cells.ar: وضعنا ملصقات على الصناديق لكي يجد الجميع أغراضهم.
cells.description: Volunteers organizing moving boxes

cells.en: She speaks clearly so that new learners can follow.
cells.ar: تتحدث بوضوح كي يتمكن المتعلمون الجدد من المتابعة.
cells.description: Instructor addressing adult beginners

cells.en: I keep a spare key so that I can get in if I lose mine.
cells.ar: أحتفظ بمفتاح احتياطي كي أتمكن من الدخول إذا أضعت مفتاحي.
cells.description: Adult placing a spare key in a secure pouch

cells.en: He moved the chair so that his grandmother could pass.
cells.ar: حرّك الكرسي لكي تتمكن جدته من المرور.
cells.description: Adult clearing a path for an elderly relative

cells.en: We packed lunch so that we could stay at the beach all day.
cells.ar: جهزنا الغداء كي نستطيع البقاء على الشاطئ طوال اليوم.
cells.description: Family packing food for the beach Stage the entire scene fully clothed on dry land; empty water, no swimmers, sunbathers or revealing background figures.

cells.en: I turned off the music so that my sister could study.
cells.ar: أطفأت الموسيقى لكي تتمكن أختي من الدراسة.
cells.description: Adult turning off a speaker beside a studying sibling

cells.en: She took a photo so that we could remember the arrangement.
cells.ar: التقطت صورة لكي نتذكر ترتيب الأشياء.
cells.description: Adult photographing an arranged workbench

title: لكي / من أجل
form: action + to + base verb for purpose

cells.en: I opened the book to check the answer.
cells.ar: فتحت الكتاب للتحقق من الإجابة.
cells.description: Learner opening a book to check an answer

cells.en: She went outside to get some fresh air.
cells.ar: خرجت لتستنشق بعض الهواء النقي.
cells.description: Woman stepping outdoors for fresh air

cells.en: We met early to plan the project.
cells.ar: التقينا مبكرًا للتخطيط للمشروع.
cells.description: Team meeting early to plan

cells.en: He called his mother to share the news.
cells.ar: اتصل بأمه ليشاركها الخبر.
cells.description: Adult sharing news with a mother by phone

cells.en: I borrowed a ladder to clean the windows.
cells.ar: استعرت سلمًا لتنظيف النوافذ.
cells.description: Adult carrying a ladder toward dusty windows

cells.en: She joined the club to meet new people.
cells.ar: انضمت إلى النادي للتعرف إلى أشخاص جدد.
cells.description: Adult joining a friendly community club

cells.en: We stopped at a cafe to rest our feet.
cells.ar: توقفنا في مقهى لنريح أقدامنا.
cells.description: Tired walkers sitting at a cafe

cells.en: He used a dictionary to check the spelling.
cells.ar: استخدم قاموسًا للتحقق من الإملاء.
cells.description: Learner checking a dictionary

cells.en: I put on my glasses to read the label.
cells.ar: ارتديت نظارتي لقراءة الملصق.
cells.description: Adult inspecting a package through glasses

cells.en: They planted trees to provide shade.
cells.ar: غرسوا أشجارًا لتوفير الظل.
cells.description: Volunteers planting young trees

cells.en: We went to the station to collect our tickets.
cells.ar: ذهبنا إلى المحطة لاستلام تذاكرنا.
cells.description: Travelers collecting station tickets

cells.en: I recorded the conversation to practice listening later.
cells.ar: سجلت المحادثة للتدرب على الاستماع لاحقًا.
cells.description: Learners making an agreed conversation recording

cells.en: Although it was late, we finished the game.
cells.ar: مع أن الوقت كان متأخرًا، أنهينا اللعبة.
cells.description: Friends finishing a game late

cells.en: Although she was tired, she kept studying.
cells.ar: رغم أنها كانت متعبة، واصلت الدراسة.
cells.description: Tired learner continuing to study

cells.en: Although the bag is small, it holds many books.
cells.ar: مع أن الحقيبة صغيرة، تتسع لكتب كثيرة.
cells.description: Adult filling a small bag with books

cells.en: Although he was nervous, he spoke clearly.
cells.ar: رغم أنه كان متوترًا، تحدث بوضوح.
cells.description: Nervous presenter speaking clearly

cells.en: Although the shop was small, it sold everything we needed.
cells.ar: مع أن المتجر كان صغيرًا، باع كل ما احتجنا إليه.
cells.description: Shoppers finding supplies in a small store

cells.en: Although I had a map, I took the wrong turn.
cells.ar: مع أن لدي خريطة، انعطفت في الاتجاه الخطأ.
cells.description: Traveler checking a map at a street corner

cells.en: Although she speaks quietly, everyone listens to her.
cells.ar: مع أنها تتحدث بهدوء، ينصت الجميع إليها.
cells.description: Quiet speaker holding a group's attention

cells.en: Although the bus was crowded, we found two seats.
cells.ar: مع أن الحافلة كانت مزدحمة، وجدنا مقعدين.
cells.description: Adults seated on a crowded bus

cells.en: Although he is busy, he calls his parents every week.
cells.ar: مع أنه مشغول، يتصل بوالديه كل أسبوع.
cells.description: Worker calling family during a break

cells.en: Although the recipe looked difficult, I managed to follow it.
cells.ar: مع أن الوصفة بدت صعبة، تمكنت من اتباعها.
cells.description: Adult preparing a complicated meal

cells.en: Although we arrived early, the tickets were sold out.
cells.ar: مع أننا وصلنا مبكرًا، كانت التذاكر قد نفدت.
cells.description: Visitors talking with a box-office clerk

cells.en: Although I made mistakes, I enjoyed speaking English.
cells.ar: مع أنني ارتكبت أخطاء، استمتعت بالتحدث بالإنجليزية.
cells.description: Adult learner enjoying conversation practice

title: مع أن / بالرغم من أن
form: even though + subject + verb, main clause

cells.en: Even though it was raining, we went outside.
cells.ar: مع أن المطر كان يهطل، خرجنا.
cells.description: Adults walking in raincoats

cells.en: Even though he was new, he led the team.
cells.ar: رغم أنه كان جديدًا، قاد الفريق.
cells.description: New colleague leading a team

cells.en: Even though the road was long, they kept walking.
cells.ar: مع أن الطريق كان طويلًا، واصلوا المشي.
cells.description: Hikers continuing on a long road

cells.en: Even though I was afraid, I asked the question.
cells.ar: رغم أنني كنت خائفًا، طرحت السؤال.
cells.description: Nervous learner asking a question

cells.en: Even though the beach was crowded, we found a quiet corner.
cells.ar: مع أن الشاطئ كان مزدحمًا، وجدنا ركنًا هادئًا.
cells.description: A modestly dressed Arab family finding a quiet shaded corner of a coastal promenade, with a busier fully clothed crowd far along the promenade and sea beyond. No swimmers, sunbathers, romance or swimwear. Stage the entire scene fully clothed on dry land; empty water, no swimmers, sunbathers or revealing background figures. Use respectful conversational distance and neutral gestures, no romantic staging or physical intimacy.

cells.en: Even though I knew the answer, I waited for my turn.
cells.ar: مع أنني كنت أعرف الإجابة، انتظرت دوري.
cells.description: Learner waiting patiently in a discussion

cells.en: Even though the phone was old, it worked perfectly.
cells.ar: مع أن الهاتف كان قديمًا، عمل بصورة ممتازة.
cells.description: Adult making a clear call on an older phone

cells.en: Even though she had little time, she prepared a lovely meal.
cells.ar: مع أن وقتها كان قليلًا، أعدت وجبة شهية.
cells.description: Woman serving a freshly prepared meal

cells.en: Even though we disagreed, we treated each other with respect.
cells.ar: مع أننا اختلفنا، عامل بعضنا بعضًا باحترام.
cells.description: Adults calmly discussing different opinions

cells.en: Even though the box was heavy, he carried it carefully.
cells.ar: مع أن الصندوق كان ثقيلًا، حمله بحذر.
cells.description: Adult carefully lifting a heavy box

cells.en: Even though I practiced, I still felt nervous.
cells.ar: مع أنني تدربت، ظللت أشعر بالتوتر.
cells.description: Prepared presenter pausing before speaking

cells.en: Even though the path was steep, my grandmother reached the top.
cells.ar: مع أن الممر كان شديد الانحدار، وصلت جدتي إلى القمة.
cells.description: Elderly hiker resting proudly at a viewpoint

cells.en: I like tea, but my sister prefers coffee.
cells.ar: أحب الشاي، لكن أختي تفضل القهوة.
cells.description: Siblings choosing tea and coffee

cells.en: The test was hard, but I passed.
cells.ar: كان الاختبار صعبًا، لكنني نجحت.
cells.description: Learner receiving a passing test result

cells.en: He is young, but he is very responsible.
cells.ar: إنه صغير، لكنه مسؤول جدًا.
cells.description: Young adult responsibly organizing a task

cells.en: The house is small, but it feels comfortable.
cells.ar: المنزل صغير، لكنه مريح.
cells.description: Adult relaxing in a comfortable small house

cells.en: The room is small, but it gets plenty of light.
cells.ar: الغرفة صغيرة، لكنها تحظى بإضاءة كثيرة.
cells.description: Adult admiring a small sunlit room

cells.en: I invited him, but he couldn't come.
cells.ar: دعوته، لكنه لم يستطع المجيء.
cells.description: Host reading a guest's polite reply

cells.en: We left early, but the traffic was terrible.
cells.ar: غادرنا مبكرًا، لكن الازدحام كان شديدًا.
cells.description: Travelers waiting in morning traffic

cells.en: She can read French, but she finds speaking difficult.
cells.ar: تستطيع قراءة الفرنسية، لكنها تجد صعوبة في التحدث.
cells.description: Learner discussing conversation practice beside a French book

cells.en: The soup tastes good, but it needs a little salt.
cells.ar: طعم الحساء جيد، لكنه يحتاج إلى قليل من الملح.
cells.description: Cook tasting soup beside a salt shaker

cells.en: He offered to help, but we had already finished.
cells.ar: عرض المساعدة، لكننا كنا قد انتهينا بالفعل.
cells.description: Volunteer arriving after a completed cleanup

cells.en: I understand your point, but I see the problem differently.
cells.ar: أفهم وجهة نظرك، لكنني أرى المشكلة بطريقة مختلفة.
cells.description: Colleagues comparing ideas calmly

cells.en: We wanted a quiet picnic, but the park was crowded.
cells.ar: أردنا نزهة هادئة، لكن الحديقة كانت مزدحمة.
cells.description: Family carrying a picnic basket in a busy park

cells.en: The bus was late. However, we arrived on time.
cells.ar: تأخرت الحافلة. ومع ذلك وصلنا في الموعد.
cells.description: Travelers arriving despite a late bus

cells.en: The book is long. However, it is easy to read.
cells.ar: الكتاب طويل. ومع ذلك يسهل قراءته.
cells.description: Adult comfortably reading a long book

cells.en: It was cold. However, the children enjoyed the walk.
cells.ar: كان الجو باردًا. ومع ذلك استمتع الأطفال بالمشي.
cells.description: Children enjoying a walk in cold weather

cells.en: She had little time. However, she finished her work.
cells.ar: كان وقتها قليلًا. ومع ذلك أنهت عملها.
cells.description: Woman completing work despite limited time

cells.en: The hotel was expensive. However, the location was excellent.
cells.ar: كان الفندق باهظ الثمن. ومع ذلك، كان موقعه ممتازًا.
cells.description: Travelers enjoying a central hotel location

cells.en: I felt nervous. However, the audience was friendly.
cells.ar: شعرت بالتوتر. ومع ذلك، كان الجمهور ودودًا.
cells.description: Presenter facing a friendly audience

cells.en: The road was long. However, we enjoyed the view.
cells.ar: كان الطريق طويلًا. ومع ذلك، استمتعنا بالمنظر.
cells.description: Travelers admiring roadside scenery

cells.en: She had never cooked it before. However, the meal tasted wonderful.
cells.ar: لم تكن قد طبخت هذه الوجبة من قبل. ومع ذلك، كان طعمها رائعًا.
cells.description: Cook serving a successful new meal

cells.en: We couldn't meet in person. However, we spoke online.
cells.ar: لم نستطع اللقاء وجهًا لوجه. ومع ذلك، تحدثنا عبر الإنترنت.
cells.description: Friends chatting on a video call

cells.en: The task looked simple. However, it took two hours.
cells.ar: بدت المهمة بسيطة. ومع ذلك، استغرقت ساعتين.
cells.description: Adults completing a lengthy repair

cells.en: I made several mistakes. However, I learned a lot.
cells.ar: ارتكبت عدة أخطاء. ومع ذلك، تعلمت الكثير.
cells.description: Learner reviewing corrected work

cells.en: The shop was crowded. However, the staff served us quickly.
cells.ar: كان المتجر مزدحمًا. ومع ذلك، خدمنا الموظفون بسرعة.
cells.description: Shop assistants efficiently helping customers

cells.en: While I enjoy reading, my brother prefers sports.
cells.ar: بينما أستمتع بالقراءة، يفضل أخي الرياضة.
cells.description: Siblings comparing reading and sports

cells.en: She likes the city, while I prefer the countryside.
cells.ar: هي تحب المدينة، بينما أفضل الريف.
cells.description: Friends comparing city and countryside preferences

cells.en: While the first room is bright, the second is quiet.
cells.ar: بينما الغرفة الأولى مضيئة، الثانية هادئة.
cells.description: Adults comparing a bright room and a quiet room

cells.en: I work in the morning, while my sister studies at night.
cells.ar: أعمل صباحًا بينما تدرس أختي ليلًا.
cells.description: Siblings discussing morning work and evening study

cells.en: While I prefer to plan ahead, my friend enjoys surprises.
cells.ar: بينما أفضل التخطيط مسبقًا، يستمتع صديقي بالمفاجآت.
cells.description: Friends comparing planned and spontaneous outings

cells.en: While this room is bright, the other one is larger.
cells.ar: بينما هذه الغرفة مضيئة، فإن الأخرى أكبر.
cells.description: Adults comparing two rooms

cells.en: While some people like spicy food, others prefer mild dishes.
cells.ar: بينما يحب بعض الناس الطعام الحار، يفضل آخرون الأطباق غير الحارة.
cells.description: Diners choosing differently spiced dishes

cells.en: While my job involves travel, hers is based in one office.
cells.ar: بينما يتطلب عملي السفر، يقتصر عملها على مكتب واحد.
cells.description: Colleagues comparing travel and office work

cells.en: While the train is faster, the bus is cheaper.
cells.ar: بينما القطار أسرع، فإن الحافلة أرخص.
cells.description: Travelers comparing transport options

cells.en: While he likes working alone, I prefer a team.
cells.ar: بينما يحب العمل وحده، أفضل العمل ضمن فريق.
cells.description: Adults discussing independent and team work

cells.en: While the blue bag is lighter, the green one holds more.
cells.ar: بينما الحقيبة الزرقاء أخف، تتسع الخضراء لأغراض أكثر.
cells.description: Shopper comparing two bags

cells.en: While we agree on the goal, we disagree about the method.
cells.ar: بينما نتفق على الهدف، نختلف حول الطريقة.
cells.description: Team comparing approaches to a shared goal

title: بدلًا من
form: instead of + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: Instead of driving, we walked to school.
cells.ar: بدلًا من القيادة، مشينا إلى المدرسة.
cells.description: Adults walking instead of driving to school

cells.en: She chose water instead of soda.
cells.ar: اختارت الماء بدلًا من المشروبات الغازية.
cells.description: Diner choosing water over soda

cells.en: Instead of watching TV, I read a book.
cells.ar: بدلًا من مشاهدة التلفاز، قرأت كتابًا.
cells.description: Adult reading a book beside a switched-off television

cells.en: We repaired the chair instead of buying a new one.
cells.ar: أصلحنا الكرسي بدلًا من شراء كرسي جديد.
cells.description: Adults repairing a chair instead of replacing it

cells.en: Instead of buying lunch, I brought food from home.
cells.ar: بدلًا من شراء الغداء، أحضرت طعامًا من المنزل.
cells.description: Worker opening homemade lunch

cells.en: Instead of the main road, we took a quieter street.
cells.ar: بدلًا من الطريق الرئيسي، سلكنا شارعًا أهدأ.
cells.description: Travelers choosing a side street

cells.en: Instead of guessing, ask someone who knows.
cells.ar: بدلًا من التخمين، اسأل شخصًا يعرف.
cells.description: Learner asking an instructor

cells.en: We used jars instead of plastic cups.
cells.ar: استخدمنا مرطبانات بدلًا من الأكواب البلاستيكية.
cells.description: Adults arranging reusable jars

cells.en: Instead of complaining about the mess, we cleaned it up.
cells.ar: بدلًا من الشكوى من الفوضى، نظفنا المكان.
cells.description: Friends cleaning a cluttered room

cells.en: She called instead of sending another message.
cells.ar: اتصلت بدلًا من إرسال رسالة أخرى.
cells.description: Adult choosing a phone call

cells.en: Instead of waiting indoors, we sat in the garden.
cells.ar: بدلًا من الانتظار في الداخل، جلسنا في الحديقة.
cells.description: Visitors waiting in a garden

cells.en: I listened carefully instead of planning my next reply.
cells.ar: أصغيت باهتمام بدلًا من التخطيط لردي التالي.
cells.description: Adult attentively listening to a friend

title: بالإضافة إلى
form: in addition to + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: In addition to English, I study mathematics.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى الإنجليزية، أدرس الرياضيات.
cells.description: Learner studying English and mathematics

cells.en: She plays tennis in addition to swimming.
cells.ar: تمارس التنس بالإضافة إلى السباحة.
cells.description: A woman in loose opaque full-coverage sports clothing and hijab holding a tennis racket and a closed sports bag with swimming goggles attached, outside a sports centre. No pool activity or swimwear. Stage the entire scene fully clothed on dry land; empty water, no swimmers, sunbathers or revealing background figures.

cells.en: In addition to reading, he enjoys writing.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى القراءة، يستمتع بالكتابة.
cells.description: Adult reading and writing at a desk

cells.en: We planted flowers in addition to vegetables.
cells.ar: زرعنا زهورًا بالإضافة إلى الخضروات.
cells.description: Adult tending flowers beside a vegetable bed Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.

cells.en: In addition to her job, she volunteers at the library.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى عملها، تتطوع في المكتبة.
cells.description: Woman shelving library books

cells.en: In addition to cooking, he enjoys gardening.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى الطبخ، يستمتع بالبستنة.
cells.description: Adult tending a kitchen garden

cells.en: We need water in addition to the food.
cells.ar: نحتاج إلى الماء بالإضافة إلى الطعام.
cells.description: Adults packing picnic water and food

cells.en: In addition to the price, consider the repair costs.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى السعر، فكر في تكاليف الإصلاح.
cells.description: Buyer discussing bicycle repair costs

cells.en: In addition to listening, I write a short summary.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى الاستماع، أكتب ملخصًا قصيرًا.
cells.description: Learner writing after an audio lesson

cells.en: In addition to a bedroom, the apartment has a study.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى غرفة نوم، تحتوي الشقة على غرفة للدراسة.
cells.description: Visitor inspecting an apartment study Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.

cells.en: In addition to helping us move, they cooked dinner.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى مساعدتنا في الانتقال، أعدوا العشاء.
cells.description: Friends dining after moving boxes

cells.en: In addition to learning new words, we practice using them.
cells.ar: بالإضافة إلى تعلم كلمات جديدة، نتدرب على استخدامها.
cells.description: Learners practicing vocabulary together

title: ليس فقط ... بل أيضًا
form: not only + parallel item + but also + parallel item

cells.en: She speaks not only English but also French.
cells.ar: هي لا تتحدث الإنجليزية فقط بل الفرنسية أيضًا.
cells.description: Adult practicing two languages

cells.en: We need not only books but also notebooks.
cells.ar: نحتاج ليس فقط كتبًا بل دفاتر أيضًا.
cells.description: Learner packing books and notebooks

cells.en: He is not only helpful but also patient.
cells.ar: ليس متعاونًا فقط بل صبور أيضًا.
cells.description: Patient colleague helping a team

cells.en: The trip was not only fun but also educational.
cells.ar: لم تكن الرحلة ممتعة فقط بل تعليمية أيضًا.
cells.description: Travelers enjoying an educational trip

cells.en: The course teaches not only vocabulary but also useful expressions.
cells.ar: لا تعلم الدورة المفردات فقط، بل التعابير المفيدة أيضًا.
cells.description: Teacher using vocabulary and conversation materials

cells.en: He not only repaired the chair but also painted it.
cells.ar: لم يصلح الكرسي فقط، بل طلاه أيضًا.
cells.description: Adult painting a repaired chair

cells.en: We need not only a plan but also enough time.
cells.ar: لا نحتاج إلى خطة فقط، بل إلى وقت كافٍ أيضًا.
cells.description: Team reviewing a plan beside a clock

cells.en: She enjoys not only drawing but also making pottery.
cells.ar: لا تستمتع بالرسم فقط، بل بصنع الفخار أيضًا.
cells.description: Artist displaying drawings and clay pots

cells.en: The room is not only quiet but also comfortable.
cells.ar: الغرفة ليست هادئة فقط، بل مريحة أيضًا.
cells.description: Adult reading in a comfortable room

cells.en: They invited not only our team but also our families.
cells.ar: لم يدعوا فريقنا فقط، بل عائلاتنا أيضًا.
cells.description: Team members arriving with relatives

cells.en: I want to improve not only my speaking but also my listening.
cells.ar: أريد تحسين التحدث لديّ، وكذلك الاستماع.
